from typing import Optional, List
from pydantic import Field

class ExtendedDocUnit(BaseDocUnit):
    section_number: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The section number of the document unit, e.g., '1.2'.")
    page_number: Optional[int] = Field(None, description="The page number where this unit appears in the document.")
    figure_refs: Optional[List[str]] = Field(None, description="References to figures mentioned in this unit.")
    table_refs: Optional[List[str]] = Field(None, description="References to tables mentioned in this unit.")

class ExtendedDoc(BaseDoc[ExtendedDocUnit]):
    authors: Optional[List[str]] = Field(None, description="List of authors of the document.")
    publication_date: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The publication date of the document in ISO format.")
    keywords: Optional[List[str]] = Field(None, description="Keywords describing the main topics of the document.")
    references: Optional[List[str]] = Field(None, description="List of bibliographic references cited in the document.")
